completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2021/ra_11591_2021.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Last Day of Registration. – The last day of registration of voters for the 2022 National and Local Elections shall be thirty (30) days after the effectivity of this Act.

Repealing Clause. – All laws, presidential decrees, executive orders, memoranda, circulars, rules and regulations, and other issuances or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed, amended, or modified accordingly.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect immediately after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
